title: Employment Traps
subtitle: employment traps = 求職陷阱；就業騙局；虛假招聘手法
description: employment traps = 求職陷阱；就業騙局；虛假招聘手法

words.note: 最直接、最常見的說法，泛指利用求職者騙取金錢、個人資料或其他利益的安排。
words.example: Students were warned about online job scams that ask applicants to pay fees in advance.

exercises.original: Students were warned about employment traps that ask applicants to pay fees in advance.
exercises.zh: 學生獲提醒要提防要求申請人預先付款的求職陷阱。
exercises.upgrade: job scams · 求職騙局；工作騙案

options.explanation: pay fees in advance 是常見求職騙局警號，因此 job scams 最精確。
bad jobs 可以只是不理想，未必欺詐。
pitfalls 範圍較廣，可包括普通錯誤。
phishing 只是其中一種可能手法。
job seekers 是求職者，不是騙局。

exercises.original: Online employment traps often promise very high pay for very little work.
exercises.zh: 網上求職騙局常聲稱只需很少工作便可獲得極高薪酬。
exercises.upgrade: job scams · 求職騙局；工作騙案

options.explanation: 不切實際的高薪承諾是典型 job scam 特徵。
scamming 是行為，不是可數騙局名稱。

exercises.original: The university ran a workshop on how graduates can recognize employment traps.
exercises.zh: 大學舉辦工作坊，教畢業生辨識求職騙局。
exercises.upgrade: job scams · 求職騙局；工作騙案

options.explanation: recognize + 求職安全教育最自然指辨識 scams。

words.note: 比 job scams 稍正式，可概括與求職、受聘或僱傭安排有關的欺詐行為。
words.example: The agency published guidance on avoiding employment scams.

exercises.original: The agency published guidance on avoiding employment traps.
exercises.zh: 該機構發布了避免墮入就業騙局的指引。
exercises.upgrade: employment scams · 就業騙局；招聘詐騙

options.explanation: 正式指引語境中，employment scams 是廣義而正式的說法。
employment gaps 是履歷中的就業空檔。

exercises.original: Authorities received hundreds of complaints about employment traps last year.
exercises.zh: 當局去年收到數百宗有關就業騙局的投訴。
exercises.upgrade: employment scams · 就業騙局；招聘詐騙

options.explanation: complaints + authorities 指向正式分類的欺詐案件。
勞資爭議不一定涉及騙局。
差劣工作條件未必是欺詐。

exercises.original: The campaign teaches workers how to report suspected employment traps.
exercises.zh: 該宣傳活動教導求職者如何舉報懷疑就業騙局。
exercises.upgrade: employment scams · 就業騙局；招聘詐騙

options.explanation: report suspected 很自然搭配 scams。
fraudulent 是形容詞，缺少名詞。

words.note: 重點放在招聘程序，例如假招聘網站、冒充招聘人員、虛假面試或收取「申請費」。
words.example: Several recruitment scams used fake company email addresses.

exercises.original: Several employment traps used fake company email addresses to contact applicants.
exercises.zh: 數宗招聘騙局使用虛假的公司電郵地址聯絡申請人。
exercises.upgrade: recruitment scams · 招聘騙局；招募詐騙

options.explanation: 假公司電郵直接出現在招聘流程，因此 recruitment scams 最精確。

exercises.original: The police said the employment traps involved fake interviews and bogus recruiters.
exercises.zh: 警方表示，相關招聘騙局涉及虛假面試和冒充招聘人員。
exercises.upgrade: recruitment scams · 招聘騙局；招募詐騙

options.explanation: fake interviews + bogus recruiters 都是招聘流程中的騙局元素。
agency 可能是真實合法機構。
單數 fraudster 是騙徒，不是騙局。

exercises.original: The company warned candidates that employment traps were using its logo without permission.
exercises.zh: 公司警告求職者，有招聘騙局未經許可使用其標誌。
exercises.upgrade: recruitment scams · 招聘騙局；招募詐騙

options.explanation: 冒用公司標誌招募求職者是典型 recruitment scam。
recruitment fraud 是不可數概念，這裡 several/scams 類型語境更適合可數名詞。

words.meaning: 具欺騙性的工作邀請；誤導性職位邀約
words.note: 強調一份 job offer 表面看似真實，但內容刻意誤導求職者。
words.example: The website removed several deceptive job offers that promised unrealistic salaries.

exercises.original: The website removed employment traps that promised unrealistic salaries.
exercises.zh: 該網站刪除了聲稱提供不切實際高薪的欺騙性工作邀請。
exercises.upgrade: deceptive job offers · 具欺騙性的工作邀請；誤導性職位邀約

options.explanation: promised unrealistic salaries 表示邀約內容刻意誤導。
job description 可真實描述職責。

exercises.original: Applicants were attracted by employment traps that hid important conditions.
exercises.zh: 申請人被隱瞞重要條件的誤導性工作邀請吸引。
exercises.upgrade: deceptive job offers · 具欺騙性的工作邀請；誤導性職位邀約

options.explanation: hid important conditions 表示 offer 具有誤導性。
招聘公告不一定有欺騙。

exercises.original: The regulator found employment traps that exaggerated both salary and promotion prospects.
exercises.zh: 監管機構發現有工作邀請誇大薪酬和晉升前景。
exercises.upgrade: deceptive job offers · 具欺騙性的工作邀請；誤導性職位邀約

options.explanation: 誇大 salary 和 promotion prospects 是典型誤導。
job adverts 可以完全真實。
抽象名詞，不能表示多份 offer。

words.meaning: 欺詐性工作邀請；虛假招聘邀請
words.note: 比 deceptive job offers 更強，明確表示有欺詐意圖。
words.example: Police investigated fraudulent job offers used to collect applicants' bank details.

exercises.original: Police investigated employment traps used to collect applicants' bank details.
exercises.zh: 警方調查利用工作邀請收集申請人銀行資料的欺詐案件。
exercises.upgrade: fraudulent job offers · 欺詐性工作邀請；虛假招聘邀請

options.explanation: 收集銀行資料顯示明確欺詐意圖，因此 fraudulent 最精確。
deceptive advertising 太廣，未必是工作邀請。
銀行表格不是工作邀請。
fraud 是抽象／不可數概念。

exercises.original: The emails contained employment traps designed to steal identity documents.
exercises.zh: 那些電郵載有旨在竊取身份文件的欺詐性工作邀請。
exercises.upgrade: fraudulent job offers · 欺詐性工作邀請；虛假招聘邀請

options.explanation: designed to steal identity documents 明確是欺詐用途。

exercises.original: The bank froze accounts linked to employment traps that demanded deposits from applicants.
exercises.zh: 銀行凍結了與要求申請人支付按金的欺詐性工作邀請有關的帳戶。
exercises.upgrade: fraudulent job offers · 欺詐性工作邀請；虛假招聘邀請

options.explanation: 要求求職者支付按金並涉及凍結帳戶，顯示欺詐性。
legitimate vacancies 與 fraud 相反。

words.meaning: 假工作邀請；虛假職位邀約
words.note: 較直接、日常，表示所謂的職位或招聘邀請其實並不存在，或由冒充僱主的人發出。
words.example: The messages contained fake job offers from companies that had never contacted the applicants.

exercises.original: The messages contained employment traps from companies that had never contacted the applicants.
exercises.zh: 訊息內載有假工作邀請，而相關公司其實從未聯絡那些申請人。
exercises.upgrade: fake job offers · 假工作邀請；虛假職位邀約

options.explanation: 公司從未聯絡申請人，表示 offer 是冒充／虛假。
notice 不一定是工作邀請。

exercises.original: Several employment traps advertised positions that did not actually exist.
exercises.zh: 數份虛假工作邀請刊登了實際並不存在的職位。
exercises.upgrade: fake job offers · 假工作邀請；虛假職位邀約

options.explanation: positions that did not actually exist 直接定義 fake job offers。
advert 只是形式，未必虛假。
動名詞，不是工作邀請名詞。

exercises.original: The platform deleted employment traps posted under the names of real companies.
exercises.zh: 平台刪除了冒用真實公司名稱發布的假工作邀請。
exercises.upgrade: fake job offers · 假工作邀請；虛假職位邀約

options.explanation: 冒用真實公司名稱發布職位表示 offer 本身是假的。
job listing 可以合法真實。
real opportunities 與 fake 相反。

words.meaning: 求職欺詐計劃；工作騙局手法
words.note: 較正式，強調有組織、有步驟的欺詐安排，而不只是一封假的工作邀請。
words.example: The report describes several job fraud schemes targeting recent graduates.

exercises.original: The report describes several employment traps targeting recent graduates.
exercises.zh: 報告描述了數種針對應屆畢業生的求職欺詐手法。
exercises.upgrade: job fraud schemes · 求職欺詐計劃；工作騙局手法

options.explanation: several ... targeting 表示有組織的多種欺詐模式。

exercises.original: Investigators uncovered employment traps involving fake recruiters, payment requests and stolen identities.
exercises.zh: 調查人員揭發涉及假招聘人員、付款要求及身份盜竊的求職欺詐計劃。
exercises.upgrade: job fraud schemes · 求職欺詐計劃；工作騙局手法

options.explanation: 多個步驟和角色組成完整欺詐安排，因此 scheme 最精確。
campaign 可是真實招聘活動。
fraud 太抽象，未突出一套 scheme。

exercises.original: The authorities linked several employment traps to the same organized group.
exercises.zh: 當局把數宗求職欺詐計劃與同一個有組織團伙聯繫起來。
exercises.upgrade: job fraud schemes · 求職欺詐計劃；工作騙局手法

options.explanation: organized group + several linked cases 表示有組織的欺詐計劃。
形容詞，詞性不合。 --- End of teaching material

falseSynonyms.zh: 差劣工作不等於求職騙局 bad jobs 可能只是薪酬低、工時長或管理差，但未必涉及欺騙。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A poorly paid job may be a bad job without being a job scam.

falseSynonyms.zh: 求職風險不等於詐騙 pitfalls 是求職時可能遇到的問題或錯誤，範圍比 scams 更廣，也可以完全沒有欺詐成分。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Interview mistakes are employment pitfalls, but they are not employment scams.

falseSynonyms.zh: 剝削性工作不等於虛假招聘 exploitative jobs 可能是真實存在的工作，只是待遇或條件不公平；scam 則涉及欺騙。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An exploitative job may be real but unfair. A fake job offer may not involve a real job at all.

falseSynonyms.zh: 釣魚詐騙只是可能使用的手法 phishing 是騙取登入資料、銀行資料等的一種網絡欺詐方法，可以被 job scams 使用，但範圍不只招聘。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A recruitment scam may use phishing emails to steal personal information.

falseSynonyms.zh: 身份盜竊是可能的後果，不等於招聘騙局本身 identity theft 是非法使用他人身份資料；employment scams 可能導致 identity theft。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A fake recruiter may collect personal data for identity theft.

falseSynonyms.zh: 層壓式推銷／金字塔騙局不等於所有 job scams pyramid scheme 是特定商業騙局模式；有些會偽裝成工作機會，但不是所有 employment traps 都屬此類。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A pyramid scheme may be advertised as a job, but many other kinds of job scams exist.

falseSynonyms.zh: 騙局和騙徒不同 scam 是騙局；scammer 是實施騙局的人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The scammer posted a fake job scam advertisement.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞和形容詞不同 fraud 是名詞；fraudulent 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The offer involved fraud. It was a fraudulent job offer.
